answer.text: The manual says not to exceed the maximum payload defined in the GMA fitting instructions for panniers and top boxes, but it gives no kilogram figure for them.
The only weight limit the manual states is the gross vehicle weight of 394 kg for the whole motorcycle, which is not a pannier or top box limit.
Do not use the vehicle beyond the allowed gross weight, because the suspension and tyres are designed to perform only up to the maximum gross vehicle weight.

watchouts.text: Loading weight incorrectly can affect stability, handling and safe operation and could cause an accident with serious injury or loss of life.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not state a pannier or top box payload in kilograms. It points to the GMA fitting instructions, which are not part of this manual, so check those instructions for the figure.
